metadata.basis: General League of Legends lane-matchup knowledge, not patch statistics
metadata.method: Three lane-group Game Designer audits plus adversarial Reality Checker refutation; only high-confidence, unrefuted changes applied

changes.reason: Malphite is a famous Yasuo counter (armor stacking, ult knock-up, Yasuo cannot trade); 1 understates it.
5 means near-unplayable, which Shyvana is not vs Sylas; at most a slight edge.
Rammus into Master Yi is among the most famous counters (taunt and armor vs auto-attack carry). Rammus has zero counter entries.
5 means near-unplayable; Yone vs Aurelion Sol is at most a modest early edge for Yone, never a near-auto-win.
